description: Permanently removes specified issues from a Sentry project; if no issue IDs are provided, it removes the oldest 1000 issues.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for `DeleteProjectIssues` action, specifying the organization, project, and optionally, specific issues to delete.

id.description: A list of specific issue IDs to be permanently removed. If not provided, the action removes the oldest 1000 issues in the project.
id.title: Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which the project and its issues belong.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry project from which issues will be removed.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: DeleteProjectIssuesRequest

name: delete_project_issues

DeleteProjectIssuesResponse.description: Response schema for `DeleteProjectIssues` action. The API returns an empty response body on success (HTTP 204/202).
